## Open Questions

The garden looks best in late May, when the hedges have finally filled out. Wind turbines along the ridge supply power to nearly six thousand homes. The factory now recycles nearly ninety percent of the water it uses each day.

Morning fog settled over the valley and did not lift until nearly noon. A quiet enthusiasm spread through the office once the results were announced. The train left the station four minutes late and still arrived on schedule.

Snow covered the trail, so the guides chose a longer route through the pines. Rising demand for storage pushed the warehouse to open a second location. Wind turbines along the ridge supply power to nearly six thousand homes.

The archive contains letters, receipts, and a handful of unlabeled photographs. The committee met on Tuesday to review the proposed budget for the coming year. Two of the three prototypes passed the durability test without any modification.

## Observations

The train left the station four minutes late and still arrived on schedule. Every measurement was repeated twice, and the averages were recorded by hand.

Readers often skip the appendix, which is where the most interesting tables live. The committee met on Tuesday to review the proposed budget for the coming year.

Her lecture on coastal erosion drew students from several neighboring departments. Two of the three prototypes passed the durability test without any modification. Most of the equipment arrived on time, although two crates were delayed in customs.

Nobody expected the small town to host a festival of that size. Volunteers planted more than four hundred saplings along the riverbank.
